summary: Faced with angry victims, a chief answers with how seldom property crimes are solved anywhere.
realLife: At a packed meeting, victims asked if the department was out of its depth. The chief said burglars are very hard to find and convict, pointed to a national clearance rate of under one in five, and another officer said the courts are slow.
sources: The Almanac (Atherton, California), 'Atherton police: At least $2M in jewelry, other items stolen this year', Feb 5, 2019: https://www.almanacnews.com/news/print/2019/02/05/atherton-police-at-least-2m-in-jewelry-other-items-stolen-this-year
